summary: Quiet day for Lasso, URLgenius, Button/Posttap and Amazon's own link tools: no news from any of them.
YouTube Shopping is expanding fast: Amazon is joining its affiliate programme in the UK, and it launched in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt.
Readwise launched a book app aimed squarely at Kindle and Goodreads readers.
LTK and ShopMy are both pushing their own shopping destinations for the holidays (LTK trend report, ShopMy's New York pop-up market).

items.title: UK creators assemble! Amazon says it is coming to YouTube's Shopping affiliate programme
items.why: UK creators can now tag Amazon products directly in videos, Shorts and lives and earn commission without a description link. More shopping happens inside the player, so fewer clicks go through links creators control.

items.title: YouTube launches shopping affiliate program in UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt
items.why: YouTube's in-video affiliate programme keeps spreading to new countries, competing with links in the description.

items.title: Don't sleep on YouTube Shopping
items.why: Amazon Influencers on Reddit say YouTube Shopping's international programmes are already paying out, so creators are trying it alongside Amazon.

items.title: Readwise takes on Amazon’s Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers
items.why: A new reading app is going after Kindle and Goodreads users. More places where readers discover books means more stores and apps a book link has to handle.

items.title: Shoppers Are Embracing Bold Prints, Relaxed Denim and Cozy Comfort, According to LTK
items.why: LTK's November trend report is another push to keep holiday shopping inside its own app.

items.title: ShopMy Is Taking Its Influencer-Curated Marketplace Offline
items.why: ShopMy is running a physical holiday market in New York to build its name with brands and shoppers.

items.title: 🚀 Better #SEO for your link in bio! You can now choose your page's H1 heading to help search engines understand your content. ✨ Automatic or manual 🎨 No design …
items.why: Link-in-bio tools are adding SEO features so creator pages rank in search, not just get clicked from bios.
